lines.en: Every hop I make sinks a patch of ground.
The landing is a bit heavy.
This body is all one lump.
I hop over that ditch.
I roll a stretch, then bounce a stretch.
I bounce toward you.
I leave pressed marks behind.
I don't turn well.
I pulse as I hop.
I inch along the ground in little arches.
I hopped over the stones.
Dust rises when I land.
I squat on the ground.
The hide keeps shifting.
I swell up suddenly.

lines.zh: 我一下就鼓起来，像颗球。
lines.en: I swell up all at once, like a ball.
My body settles down.
Squatting is all I do.
I swell and deflate, breathing slowly.
The soil I crouch on is loose and soft.
I squat without moving.
My color is very dark.
You have to look up to see me.
This hide is thick.
Your blows don't hurt me.
Lying on stone, I blend in.

lines.zh: 我跳起来的时候别站在前面。
lines.en: Don't stand in front when I hop.
You have fresh blood on you.
All this weight cannot dodge.
That armor won't stop me.
I have not shifted from here.
Two steps back, please.
A dent in my hide.
I take the hit and bounce back half a block.

lines.zh: 这一下陷进皮里就没了。
lines.en: That sank into hide and vanished.
When I cry out, it muffles.
The herpling crouches, ready to spring.
The hide swelled back out.
Your hand must be stinging.
The wound is inside this layer.
The blow leaves only a dent in my hide.
I sink half a finger into the dirt.
The thing you are holding is catching the light.
I don't much eat that.
I can't smell it.
This shell of mine is twenty-six thick.
A piece that small will not fill my mouth.
I don't need it at all.
You're blocking my way with it.
I could take it in one mouthful.
Keep that for yourself.
This smell is too faint; I do not know it.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
After the hit I am still here.

lines.zh: 弹回来的力道够你受的。
lines.en: That bounce-back should hurt plenty.
You stepped on me.
I'm a little soft.
There's mud on your boots.
Now we're stuck.
I press in a little.
You're covered in blood.
One block back is enough.
Two of me pressed together.
It isn't a pretty thing.
Don't stand there.
It stands half a head lower.
We squashed together a while.
We pressed a hollow in the ground.
Afterwards we roll our own ways.
The dust never settled.
Only a dull thud came out.
Call it fusing.
I roll it underneath myself.

lines.zh: 我把一块石头裹进皮里。
lines.en: I fold a stone under my hide.

lines.zh: 这东西压得我直往下沉。
lines.en: This thing presses me straight down.
I pinch it in my grip.
I can swallow this.
I wrap it into my hide.
It slides off my hide twice.
I wrapped up what you dropped.
I shoulder it out of the way.

lines.zh: 我这钳子，拿东西不太行。
lines.en: These pincers aren't much for holding things.
You are within one drop of me.
I hear you tread the soil.
I go at you in one hop.
I am used to crouching on this patch.
I remember that hit.
I get quite high when I jump.
You are against the rock face.
I can be there in one hop.
My hide has pulled tight.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这个重。
lines.en: Armor won't stop this weight.
I'm counting how many hops left.
The rock wall has you blocked on this side.
This hop takes everything.
The breath you pant out is warm.
I've drawn closer.
Done swinging?
I do not shout; I just spring and press.
The dust jumps with me.
I follow you hop by hop.

lines.zh: 一百一十四点生命，我跳得比你快。
lines.en: A hundred fourteen health, and I hop faster.
I come low along the ground.
Not fast, but I stop when I like.
You have changed footing twice.
I flattened a stretch of grass.
My body blocks the light.
You are against the rock wall; I am in no hurry.
I'm close by.
The prints on the ground are mine.
Hear that dull thud?
Two more hops.
You keep panting.
No rush. I press on slowly.
There's a narrow way ahead.
I tipped down from above.
Your armor plates are rattling.
I know this area.
You're getting wetter.
The last hop.
I hop and land on you.

lines.zh: 这一下砸得土都飞起来。
lines.en: This blow throws the dirt up.

lines.zh: 我把重量全压在你身上。
lines.en: I put all my weight onto you.
I roll my whole body at you.
My hide wraps around you.
You fell back two steps.
That landed with a dull thud.
There's a mark on you.

lines.zh: 三十三点伤害，我一下顶到。
lines.en: Thirty-three damage in one lunge.
I'm not good at holding back.
Your shield can't hold me.
I press down and the dirt squeezes out both sides.
I put my whole bulk into it.
You're losing your footing.
I press again, slowly.
My shell hits solid.
My hide has gone hard.

lines.zh: 你背后是石壁，退不动了。
lines.en: There is rock behind you now; you cannot back away.
I finish one press and roll back in.
That should be enough.
A hump rises out of the ground.
The ground shook when I landed.
The dirt here is dry enough to crack.

lines.zh: 我从岩层里一点点挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the rock layer bit by bit.
My hide is still soft.
I swelled once.

lines.zh: 这地方只有我的呼吸声。
lines.en: The only sound here is my breathing.
I looked about.
I propped myself steady.
A round mark is left on the ground.
I pushed up from under the rubble.
First I tested my own weight.
Fire hardened my hide.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，摔得扁了。
lines.en: I fell from height and flattened.
Water wrapped me up at once.
The blast flipped me over.
The arrow sank into the hide.

lines.zh: 这光让我的皮一下松了。
lines.en: That light loosened my hide.
Hunger deflates me.
Lightning struck and I went numb.
No ground to press in the void.
